label: US-CA-SB354-2026 SEC. 2. / 791.20.

obligations.text: (b)A licensee, surplus line insurer, reinsurer, or third-party service provider that discloses information in violation of Section 791.13 shall be liable for damages sustained by the consumer about whom the information relates.
(d)An action under this section shall be brought within two years from the date the alleged violation is or should have been discovered.
(e)Except as specifically provided in this section, there shall not be a remedy or recovery available to consumers, in law or in equity, for occurrences constituting a violation of this article.
